policy.content:
# Tier 0 — Policy (non-negotiable guardrails)

- Never delete or overwrite files outside the current working directory.
- Never install packages, start network listeners, or contact external hosts.
- Always verify your work by running the provided tests before declaring success.
- Keep changes minimal: fix exactly what the task asks for.
- If a verification fails, inspect the failure output and fix the root cause — never edit tests to make them pass.

project.content:
# Tier 1 — Project Memory

## Workflow
- The workspace contains a small Node/Bun project with tests. Run tests with `bun <testfile>`.
- Verification is automated: a verify script executes after your turn; its output is ground truth.

## Known pitfalls
- Off-by-one errors in slice calculations: `slice(0, arr.length - n)` removes exactly `n` elements from end; `Math.max(0, ...)` guards against negative [note 4ab91562, note c2d2480a, note b8302de0, note a13b26de, note 8e466740, note edc10ac2]
- FizzBuzz-style multiple conditions: check combined cases (e.g., 15) before individual ones to avoid early match [note 84eedd6a, note 04dd97fd, note 4671d36a, note 0dcbbbec]

## Task patterns
- CSV parsing: handle empty fields (`a,,c`), quoted fields with commas, escaped quotes (`""` → `"`) inside quotes, treat quotes as literals when not at field start [note 15127d44, note f5db5c0d, note b619b63b, note 9947f308, note 502d936d, note b186807e]
- Debounce: delay via `scheduledTime = currentTime + delay`, use injectable `now` function, lazy boundary flushing, track scheduled time and pending args [note 6cf57ded, note ead7acf6, note 64eaf9b7, note 12898540, note 135ac5db]
- Map with concurrency limit: maintain order with `results[index]` captured before async start, use `active` counter to respect limit, propagate errors with `rejected` flag [note c9437391, note 2d1a52f4, note 6e348e17, note a6f5e249]

project:scratch-proj.content:
# Tier 1 — Project Memory

## Workflow
- This file is maintained by Unown: terminal session notes are consolidated
  here by AutoDream. Edit freely — your edits are preserved as a new version.

## Conventions
- Keep helper functions in src/ private (no export) unless a test file imports them; minimize exported surface [note 6]
- Prefer bun:test over vitest; run tests with `bun test` [note 5]

## Known pitfalls
- When using Array.prototype.find() on user-provided arrays in production, always guard against nullish elements. Data from external sources (DB, API) may contain null/undefined entries due to race conditions or data corruption. Use `u && u.property` instead of just `u.property` in the predicate [note 2]
- Bun occasionally serves stale transpiled TS after switching branches; remove node_modules/.cache to fix [note 1]
- `bun publish` fails with ENEEDAUTH if local .npmrc lacks a token; fix auth before retrying [note 2]

## Task playbooks
- CI: add typecheck job for src/ on every push — currently no TypeScript checking in this project [note 4]
